lines.zh: 我在土里走，你看不见
lines.en: I walk through the earth; you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 土层在我身上合拢又分开
lines.en: The soil closes over me and parts again.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下三格的位置
lines.en: I am three blocks beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 挖一下，停一下，别让你听见
lines.en: A dig, then a pause, so you do not hear.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根往前拱
lines.en: I tunnel along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 石头太硬，我绕过去
lines.en: Stone is too hard; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我的路线跟着你的脚步
lines.en: My path follows your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我把碎土推到身后
lines.en: I push the loose earth behind me.

lines.zh: 头顶的土层只剩薄薄一层
lines.en: Only a thin crust of earth above me now.

lines.zh: 我在下面挪动，草都不动
lines.en: I shift below, and not a blade of grass moves.

lines.zh: 地下很安静，我听得见你的脚
lines.en: So quiet below, I can hear your feet.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向，朝你那侧偏过去
lines.en: I change direction, angling toward your side.

lines.zh: 我埋在一层土下，等机会
lines.en: I lie under a layer of earth, waiting.

lines.zh: 地面鼓起一小块，又平了
lines.en: The ground bulges slightly, then smooths.

lines.zh: 我能闻到你站的那片土
lines.en: I can smell the soil where you stand.

lines.zh: 我的爪子很长，专门挖东西
lines.en: My claws are long, made for digging.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以没有声音
lines.en: I do not breathe, so I make no sound.

lines.zh: 头顶那块土是我留的
lines.en: That patch of earth above is what I left.

lines.zh: 我在算还要挖多久
lines.en: I am counting how much further to dig.

lines.zh: 你在上面走动，我在下面数
lines.en: You pace above; I count below.

lines.zh: 碎石掉下来，我接住了
lines.en: Falling gravel; I catch it.

lines.zh: 这一带土质软，很好挖
lines.en: The soil here is soft, easy to dig.

lines.zh: 我停在墙根，那里最结实
lines.en: I stop at the wall base; it is sturdiest there.

lines.zh: 我离地表只有一格
lines.en: I am one block from the surface.

lines.zh: 土层里有树根，我绕开
lines.en: There are roots in the soil; I go around them.

lines.zh: 我在等你站在我正上方
lines.en: I am waiting for you to stand right above me.

lines.zh: 我从土里抬头，只露出眼睛
lines.en: I lift only my eyes out of the soil.

lines.zh: 地面裂开一条缝，是我
lines.en: A crack opens in the ground; it is me.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块土松了
lines.en: The earth under your feet has loosened.

lines.zh: 我从下往上看你，很近
lines.en: I look up at you from below, very close.

lines.zh: 你先听见声音，才看见我
lines.en: You hear me before you see me.

lines.zh: 我伸出爪子，扒住土边
lines.en: I reach out and grip the edge of the ground.

lines.zh: 我们只隔着一层土
lines.en: Only a layer of soil between us.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底就在我头顶
lines.en: Your soles are right above my head.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，看你的脚
lines.en: I tilt my head to look at your feet.

lines.zh: 泥土从我的肩上滑下去
lines.en: Soil slides off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我停在那里，看你敢不敢动
lines.en: I hold still and see whether you dare move.

lines.zh: 我不往上爬，只是看着
lines.en: I do not climb up; I only watch.

lines.zh: 下面的土一直在响
lines.en: The earth below keeps clicking.

lines.zh: 你别往后退，后面也是我挖的
lines.en: Do not step back; I dug behind you too.

lines.zh: 我从洞里探出来，很慢
lines.en: I emerge from the hole, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的脸离你可能只有一格
lines.en: My face may be one block from yours.

lines.zh: 你看土，土里有一双眼
lines.en: Look at the ground; there are eyes in it.

lines.zh: 我一动，土就跟着塌
lines.en: When I move, the earth collapses with me.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，土掉进喉咙
lines.en: I open my mouth and dirt falls in.

lines.zh: 这一幕你会在睡觉时想起来
lines.en: You will remember this when you try to sleep.

lines.zh: 我缩回土里，只剩眼睛
lines.en: I sink into the soil, eyes only.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了一半
lines.en: That took half of what I have.

lines.zh: 我叫得比出现时还尖
lines.en: I shriek sharper than when I appeared.

lines.zh: 土灌进伤口，很凉
lines.en: Soil fills the wound, cold.

lines.zh: 我往深处退了两格
lines.en: I retreat two blocks deeper.

lines.zh: 这点血，经不起第二下
lines.en: This little life cannot take a second blow.

lines.zh: 我用爪子扒着土往后拖
lines.en: I claw at the soil to drag myself back.

lines.zh: 我喘不上气，土太厚
lines.en: I cannot catch my breath; the soil is too thick.

lines.zh: 隧道塌了一段，我绕开
lines.en: Part of the tunnel collapsed; I go around.

lines.zh: 你会再看见我的，别急
lines.en: You will see me again; do not rush.

lines.zh: 你放在地上的东西，我从下面拿了
lines.en: What you set down, I took from below.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只想要你低头
lines.en: I do not eat; I want you to look down.

lines.zh: 土松了，你该看见了
lines.en: The soil loosened; you should see it now.

lines.zh: 我伸手够了够，差一点
lines.en: I reach for it and miss by a little.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进土里
lines.en: I drag it down into the earth.

lines.zh: 你弯腰的那一刻，我就在这里
lines.en: When you bend down, I am right here.

lines.zh: 这东西引不出我，只引你靠近
lines.en: That will not draw me out, only draw you close.

lines.zh: 我拨了拨土，让它滚下去
lines.en: I loosen the soil and let it roll down.

lines.zh: 你真低头了
lines.en: You actually looked down.

lines.zh: 拿出来的时候，我的手一起伸出来
lines.en: As you pull it out, my hand comes too.

lines.zh: 你踩塌了我上方的土
lines.en: You have collapsed the earth above me.

lines.zh: 土块砸在我背上，我没动
lines.en: Clods hit my back; I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我顶了一下地面，你跳开了
lines.en: I heave against the ground and you leap.

lines.zh: 我们在地表下撞上了
lines.en: We collide just beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得缩回土里
lines.en: Your impact knocks me back into the soil.

lines.zh: 洞壁塌了，我埋了一半
lines.en: The tunnel wall caves and buries half of me.

lines.zh: 我扒着土边，慢慢退下去
lines.en: I grip the edge and sink back down.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的隧道断了
lines.en: That broke my tunnel in two.

lines.zh: 我停住，重新挖方向
lines.en: I stop and dig a new heading.

lines.zh: 你在上面，我在下面，这样最好
lines.en: You above, me below; that is best.

lines.zh: 我只在土里遇到同类
lines.en: I only meet my own kind underground.

lines.zh: 我们挖的隧道会连在一起
lines.en: Our tunnels connect when we meet.

lines.zh: 两双手一起挖，很快
lines.en: Two pairs of hands dig fast.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只听得见土声
lines.en: We do not speak; only the digging sounds.

lines.zh: 你守着出口，我往里挖
lines.en: You guard the opening; I dig inward.

lines.zh: 这种相伴，见不得光
lines.en: This company cannot bear the light.

lines.zh: 我们从不一起露头
lines.en: We never surface at the same time.

lines.zh: 隧道尽头就是我们的家
lines.en: The end of the tunnel is our home.

lines.zh: 你把土推给我，我推回去
lines.en: You push soil to me and I push it back.

lines.zh: 上面的世界，我们都不去
lines.en: Neither of us goes to the world above.

lines.zh: 我抓了一把土，不是它
lines.en: I grab a fistful of soil, not it.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进洞里，土跟着塌
lines.en: I drag it into the hole and the earth follows.

lines.zh: 我拿起它的时候，手是湿的
lines.en: My hand is wet when I lift it.

lines.zh: 这东西在下面没用
lines.en: This thing is useless down here.

lines.zh: 我抓着它，爪尖刮出声音
lines.en: I grip it, my claws scraping.

lines.zh: 我就在洞口拿着它看你
lines.en: I hold it at the mouth of the hole and look at you.

lines.zh: 一松手，它就掉回土里
lines.en: I let go and it drops back into the soil.

lines.zh: 我把它埋了，埋得很深
lines.en: I bury it, deep.

lines.zh: 我拿起来闻了闻，土味更重
lines.en: I sniff it; the smell of soil is stronger.

lines.zh: 我伸出的手比东西更值得看
lines.en: The hand I reach out with is worth more attention.

lines.zh: 你站在软土上，我选中了这里
lines.en: You stand on soft soil; I have chosen this spot.

lines.zh: 石头少的地方，我挖得快
lines.en: Where stone is scarce, I dig fast.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声传到我这里了
lines.en: Your footsteps reach me down here.

lines.zh: 我不从正面来，我从下面来
lines.en: I do not come from the front; I come from below.

lines.zh: 这一片地底都是我的路
lines.en: All this ground is my road.

lines.zh: 我算好了，你走三步就到
lines.en: I have it counted: three of your steps and you arrive.

lines.zh: 我停下来，就在你脚下
lines.en: I stop, right beneath you.

lines.zh: 头顶那层土已经很薄
lines.en: The crust above is already thin.

lines.zh: 我要在你最放松的时候上来
lines.en: I come up when you are most at ease.

lines.zh: 我听到你放下东西了
lines.en: I heard you set something down.

lines.zh: 这地方四面是墙，我绕不过去
lines.en: Walls on all sides; I cannot go around.

lines.zh: 那我就在正下方等
lines.en: Then I will wait directly below.

lines.zh: 我选了一个最不可能的位置
lines.en: I picked the least likely spot.

lines.zh: 我要先尖叫，再跑
lines.en: I will scream first, then flee.

lines.zh: 这一带的土太硬，我得更慢
lines.en: The soil is hard here; I must go slower.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块地，底下是空的
lines.en: The ground you tread is hollow beneath.

lines.zh: 我在下面跟着，一铲一铲
lines.en: I follow below, shovelful by shovelful.

lines.zh: 你换了房间，我就换隧道
lines.en: You change rooms; I change tunnels.

lines.zh: 我听你的脚步判断位置
lines.en: I track your position by your steps.

lines.zh: 你停下来了，我也不动
lines.en: You stopped, so I stop too.

lines.zh: 我不会从同一个洞出来两次
lines.en: I never come out of the same hole twice.

lines.zh: 你在木地板上，我挖不动
lines.en: You are on wooden floor; I cannot dig.

lines.zh: 我就等在下面，等得起的
lines.en: I wait below; I can afford to wait.

lines.zh: 墙根是我的路标
lines.en: Wall bases are my landmarks.

lines.zh: 每挖一段，我就听一次
lines.en: Every few digs, I listen.

lines.zh: 我不快，但我一直在
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 你听到的那声轻响，是我碰到石头
lines.en: That click you heard was me hitting stone.

lines.zh: 我绕开那处积水
lines.en: I detour around the pooled water.

lines.zh: 地道里越来越窄，我得改道
lines.en: The tunnel narrows; I must reroute.

lines.zh: 你只要站在土地上，我就能到
lines.en: Stand on soil and I can reach you.

lines.zh: 我数着还有几格
lines.en: I count the remaining blocks.

lines.zh: 我把最后的土留着，先不动
lines.en: I leave the last layer of soil untouched.

lines.zh: 上面安静了，你在等什么
lines.en: It has gone quiet up there; what are you waiting for?

lines.zh: 我再靠近一点，只露爪子
lines.en: I come a little closer, only claws showing.

lines.zh: 你听见了，我也知道你听见了
lines.en: You heard it, and I know you did.

lines.zh: 再一下，就够了
lines.en: One more, and it is enough.

lines.zh: 土炸开，我从下面窜出来
lines.en: The soil bursts and I erupt from below.

lines.zh: 我尖叫了一声，声音很尖
lines.en: I let out a shriek, high and thin.

lines.zh: 我只是想吓你，不想打
lines.en: I only want to scare you, not fight.

lines.zh: 爪子抓了一下，立刻缩回土里
lines.en: One rake of claws, then straight back into the soil.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边冲出，又退回去
lines.en: I burst out at your feet and pull back.

lines.zh: 泥土糊了你一身
lines.en: Mud splatters all over you.

lines.zh: 我露头只有一瞬
lines.en: I show my head for a single instant.

lines.zh: 我这具身体经不起一下
lines.en: This body could not take one hit.

lines.zh: 我抓完就跑，腿都发抖
lines.en: I strike and flee, my legs shaking.

lines.zh: 这不是攻击，这是警告
lines.en: This is not an attack; it is a warning.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着退回隧道
lines.en: Shrieking, I retreat down the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，我知道
lines.en: I cannot beat you; I know that.

lines.zh: 土塌下来盖住我
lines.en: The earth collapses over me.

lines.zh: 我的爪子只是挖土的，不是武器
lines.en: My claws are for digging, not for war.

lines.zh: 这一下之后，我会躲很久
lines.en: After this I will hide for a long time.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，只剩一个洞
lines.en: When you look back, there is only a hole.

lines.zh: 地面先裂开一条线
lines.en: A line splits the ground first.

lines.zh: 我一共只有一点血，谁都知道
lines.en: I have only a sliver of life; everyone knows.

lines.zh: 硬土够多，我就能挖到这里
lines.en: Enough solid earth, and I can dig here.

lines.zh: 土里传来抓挠的声音
lines.en: Scratching sounds come from the soil.

lines.zh: 我从墙根下拱出来
lines.en: I push up at the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 这地方的地层很厚，很合适
lines.en: The strata here are thick; perfect.

lines.zh: 我先在下面绕了一圈
lines.en: I went around once beneath first.

lines.zh: 泥土翻起来，像被什么顶开
lines.en: The soil turns over as if pushed up.

lines.zh: 没有人看见我是怎么来的
lines.en: No one saw how I arrived.

lines.zh: 我破土的那一刻，会尖叫
lines.en: When I break the surface, I will scream.

lines.zh: 我停了很久才敢露头
lines.en: I waited a long time before showing myself.

lines.zh: 这一片地底，我已经摸熟了
lines.en: I know this stretch of underground well.

lines.zh: 石头缝里透下来一点光
lines.en: A little light leaks down through the rocks.

lines.zh: 我先挖出了一条退路
lines.en: First I dug myself an escape route.

lines.zh: 土味混着潮气，很适合我
lines.en: Damp-smelling soil; just right for me.

lines.zh: 我是从下面来的，不是从门来的
lines.en: I came from below, not through a door.

lines.zh: 我缩在洞里，看上面有没有人
lines.en: I crouch in the hole, checking for anyone above.

lines.zh: 你先听见的，会是抓土声
lines.en: The first thing you hear will be digging.

lines.zh: 这里的土松，我做得很快
lines.en: Loose soil here; I work quickly.

lines.zh: 我只剩一点血，所以我很小心
lines.en: I have only a sliver of life, so I am careful.

lines.zh: 火烤着土，我烫得往下钻
lines.en: Fire bakes the soil; I drill downward.

lines.zh: 我掉进自己挖的坑，摔得发懵
lines.en: I fall into my own pit, dazed.

lines.zh: 水灌满隧道，我呛得直抓
lines.en: Water floods the tunnel; I claw and choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我连土一起掀出来
lines.en: The blast throws me out with the soil.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我肩，我尖叫
lines.en: An arrow pierces my shoulder; I shriek.

lines.zh: 一股力穿过土层找到我
lines.en: A force reaches through the earth to me.

lines.zh: 我没什么可吃的，也不需要
lines.en: There is nothing to eat here, and I need nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打在地表，整条隧道都在震
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface and the whole tunnel shakes.

lines.zh: 土没了，我在空中乱抓
lines.en: No earth left; I claw at empty air.
